cohort: 1,212,589 women with GDM who delivered between 2015 and 2019 in the United States
finding: GDM was identified as an independent predictor of various adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including cesarean section, maternal blood transfusion, intensive care unit admission, neonatal intensive care unit admission, assisted ventilation, and low 5-minute Apgar score.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate among women with GDM was 46.5%.
